summary: Baldpate Hill lookout in Georgetown, first operated in 1912; the current tower dates to 1969 or 1970 and is listed as standing and active.

facts.design: Current tower with a 10x10-foot cab and a catwalk on the roof (registry); FFLA describes a 68-foot Aermotor tower
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

access.note: FFLA says the tower sits on private property; it is an active state tower, and no public visiting or rental information was found.

events.note: First tower; first date of operation August 1, 1912; 38 ft per FFLA, 30 ft per registry
Registry dates a 40-foot tower on Baldpate Hill to 1917; FFLA says a 40-foot Acushnet tower replaced the original in 1938
Original tower replaced with an old 40-foot tower from Acushnet
Current tower built by the state Bureau of Forest Fire Control; FFLA dates it to 1970 and gives 68 ft
Registered June 30, 2004 as US 589, MA 16; nominated by Henry Isenberg
State listing (last updated 5/8/2016) shows the tower standing and active

notes_for_editor: Several dates and sizes conflict. First tower: 38 ft (FFLA) vs 30 ft (registry), first used 1912 (FFLA). The 40-foot tower: built 1917 (registry) vs a 40-foot Acushnet tower moved in 1938 (FFLA). Current tower: 1969 (registry and the record) vs 1970 (FFLA); 70 ft (registry) vs 68 ft (FFLA). Elevation 347 ft (registry) vs 353 ft (FFLA); the record's 105.8 m is close to the registry's 106 m. State tower number is #27 on the 2016 state listing and #19 on the FFLA page. The FFLA 'private property' note is undated and may describe the original 1912 arrangement, so the access level 'private' should be checked with the Bureau before any visit guidance. Current access and rental unknown. No staffing history found. Search summaries stated more detail (1938 and 1944 changes, 1970 date) that I checked only against the FFLA page, so only page-read facts are used.
